name: Manila to Puerto Princesa, Mindoro Strait denied
purpose: A short move inside the Philippines, from Manila to Palawan. With no areas, the best route goes south through the Mindoro Strait, 407 nm. A 60 nm area of denial over the Mindoro Strait sends the route east of Mindoro, through the Tablas Strait and south across the Sulu Sea, about 265 nm longer. A move this short is changed a great deal by a small area. The Mindoro and Tablas Straits are not tagged as passages in the data, so the check is on length.
